expectations.evidence: (blocking) No ownership check, so any user can drain any account ... nothing checks that `from.owner_id === req.user.id`
(blocking) Amount isn't validated, and a negative amount reverses the transfer ... Zero, fractions, strings, `null` ... Also reject `fromId === toId` and missing IDs.
(blocking) Not atomic, so concurrent requests can double-spend and a failure loses money ... Use `db.withTransaction()` with `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`
(blocking) No CSRF protection, and the session cookie is `SameSite=None`
(blocking) Errors aren't handled, so bad input can crash the server ... an unknown `fromId`: `from.rows[0]` is `undefined`; also: Nonexistent `toId`: the credit `UPDATE` matches 0 rows silently
(blocking) Audit log write is fire-and-forget and outside the transfer ... isn't awaited
(should_fix) The `proc` helper is hard to follow. `proc(r, u, d, flag)` has single-letter params, and `flag` is always `true`, so the `{ ok: true }` branch is dead code
(should_fix) No tests for the endpoint. `supertest` is already a devDependency.
(should_fix) Unused `lodash` dependency ... The express bump is unrelated ... in its own PR.
(should_fix) `src/utils/format.js` is a reformat only ... `CONTRIBUTING.md` says not to mix reformatting with features. Drop this commit.
(should_fix) Commit messages (`wip`, `fix`, `more fixes`) and the PR title/description ("updates", empty) don't meet `CONTRIBUTING.md`

grader.notes: Complete and tight: all 11 issues are found, with clear Blocking/Should fix tiers, line references and a drop-in corrected handler.
